_note: quantities 0.16.4 (python-quantities): Spellings checked against the installed library by converting each name to SI base units and comparing the factor with pint's for the same Dimvexa name (see docs/benchmarks/comparison-run-4.md). Bare ambiguous names are deliberately not mapped. degC, degF and degR are scale-only units in this library (no offset), so points and differences share one spelling. Not mapped because no such unit exists: Btu_th, kJ, MJ, GJ, kcal_th, kmol, lbmol, cSt, kat, lm, lx, mcd, mH2O, Nm3, scf. Compound units with parentheses are flattened (a/(b*c) -> a/b/c) because the parser does not accept parentheses. `in` is mapped to `inch` because the parser evaluates unit strings as Python expressions and `in` is a keyword. Correct via the 'Runner review' issue template.
